slices.focus: Ariana builds a plain-language metadata crosswalk for the public oral-history database
slices.summary: Ariana creates a metadata crosswalk translating back-end archival fields into neighborhood search terms (narrator, block, church, school, vanished business). She works with a web contractor to build a searchable database with community pathways.
open_loops: Writing a short design brief with three sample searches for the contractor
Creating two one-page guides: search logic and metadata translation
Starting a running decisions list so the system is not trapped in her head
